title: Hold a TGA licence to manufacture medicines
what: A business that carries out a step in manufacturing therapeutic goods for use in humans in Australia needs a manufacturing licence and must meet the manufacturing principles (GMP), unless the goods or the business are exempt.

sources.title: Therapeutic Goods Act 1989
sources.quote: (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person, at premises in Australia, carries out a step in the manufacture of therapeutic goods (other than goods exempt under section 18A or 32CB); and (b) the goods are for supply for use in humans;
